messages:
toni: heads-up: multiple customers escalated p99 latency spikes on /v1/generate since ~09:10 PDT. they see timeouts and long tails. ticket refs: #4351, #4352. any immediate mitigations?

maria: on it — which regions affected and any sample request ids you can paste?

sam: seeing p99 jump in us-west1 and eu-west1 around 09:07. charts show redwood-neo-1.2 rollout at 09:05 correlated with spike. p95 up too but p99 worse.

devops-bot: deploy: redwood/runner rolled: redwood-neo-1.2 -> 09:05:12 by ci/canary-pipeline

lee: priority: open circuit-breaker for that route and route traffic to fallback model variant (redwood-neo-1.1-quant). steps below.

lee: ```
1) set route policy
curl -X POST https://internal-routing/api/set-policy -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","policy":"fallback:redwood-neo-1.1-quant"}'

2) enable circuit breaker
curl -X POST https://ops-api/guardrail -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","breaker":true,"threshold_ms":1000}'
```

maria: also enable emergency account-level rate-limits (20r/min) for heavy customers to protect backend. i'll push config now.

maria: ```
POST /internal/ratelimit
{
  "selector": "account:*",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "limit": "20/min",
  "burst": 5
}
```

sam: spinning up temporary extra capacity in us-west1 (add 2x small GPU nodes) and enabling prefix-KV cache for hot prompts. starting now.

naga: please prepare a short status page blurb and customer message. mention fallback model and temporary rate-limits. i'll draft the copy.

toni: support update drafted, will notify affected customers. can we have circuit-breaker return 429 + Retry-After instead of 504 timeouts?

lee: yes — 429 with `Retry-After: 20` is safer. also set SLO guardrail: if p99 > 750ms for > 5m then auto-fallback to smaller model and reduce worker concurrency.

sam: rolled back canary in eu-west1; starting rollback in us-west1. observing p99 dropping in eu-west1 already :thumbsup:.

maria: great. capture request ids and example payloads for postmortem. toni — can you collect three sanitized repro payloads?

toni: on it. compiling affected accounts list and attaching response codes to the ticket.

maria: :warning: followups — write a short mitigation playbook and drop into eng-oncall runbook. cc @lee @sam for steps and runbook edits.

lee: i'll update runbook to include: automatic fallback to quantized smaller model, emergency ratelimit endpoint snippet, circuit-breaker templates (429 + Retry-After), and pager rotation. ETA ~2h.

naga: product follow-up: schedule perf regression analysis for redwood-neo-1.2 (kernel selection/quantization path). add to next sprint.

devops-bot: metric alert: p99 for /v1/generate back to baseline in eu-west1 (09:22).

sam: will keep thread open until eu+us stable. if anyone sees requeue or repeat spikes ping me directly.

toni: thanks all — support will send final customer note once both regions are stable.
